subject: Coordinated tenor repack & staged uptier roadmap for Brightwell
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara@brightwell.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal discussion — term packaging options

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a short proposal that does three things we discussed: (1) moves Brightwell from a 12‑month subscription to a 24‑month repack with a staged upsize schedule, (2) aligns the new term to Brightwell's fiscal Oct 1 boundary so future co‑terming is easier, and (3) includes an auto‑renew opt‑out window at 60 days before renewal (so you keep control).

Key bullets:
- Base commit: convert remaining 12 mo to 24 mo at current effective rate for year 1, with a 6% per‑year escalator built into year 2.
- Staged uptier: 0% increase months 1–3 (stabilize), +20% tokens month 4–9, +40% month 10 onwards (gated by usage signals). We will provide monthly true‑up reports.
- Co‑terming: We propose aligning the contract boundary to 2027‑10‑01. This gives a single renewal window for your teams and simplifies procurement.
- Procurement & SOW: Attached is a short spreadsheet showing cashflow, price ladder, and the SOW draft. If procurement needs a different billing cadence we can show quarterly invoicing in the SOW.

Next steps I recommend: 1) You review the attached sheet; 2) Procurement confirms preferred invoicing cadence; 3) We send an updated SOW + DocuSign link.

Attachments: 2026-10-02_Brightwell_repack_summary.xlsx, Brightwell_MAAP_pricing_v2.pdf

Happy to hop on a 20‑minute call if it helps.

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Sara Lin <sara@brightwell.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal discussion — term packaging options

Thanks Rafael — this looks promising. A couple quick questions from procurement and engineering:

1) Engineering asked whether the staged uptier can be tied to actual token thresholds (e.g., move to +20% only after 200M tokens/mo sustained for 2 months). Is that something Redwood can automate in the rollout policy?
2) Procurement: can you do annual invoicing instead of monthly? They prefer a single invoice per year when possible.
3) Legal asked about the auto‑renew opt‑out window; can we make it 90 days instead of 60?

If you can update the SOW with those options we can fast‑track approval.

—Sara
VP, Product Operations | Brightwell Analytics
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara@brightwell.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal discussion — term packaging options

Sara — great questions, all feasible. Short answers below and I've updated the spreadsheet with the alternate scenarios (attached).

1) Threshold gating: yes — our rollouts support policy rules based on 30/60/90d moving averages. We can configure the staged uptier to trigger once you hit a 200M tokens/mo sustained threshold for 60 days; ops will also create a manual override path for discretionary pauses during known runs.

2) Annual invoicing: we can invoice annually (Net 30) for the 24‑month repack; if you pick annual billing there is a 1.5% processing premium compared to upfront annual prepay, which I called out in the sheet.

3) Auto‑renew window: we can extend to 90 days. We typically include a 60–90 day window in enterprise SOWs; 90 is acceptable.

Next actions: I attached Brightwell_MAAP_pricing_v2.pdf and a second worksheet that shows the threshold‑gated uptier. If procurement confirms annual invoicing and legal signs off on 90 days I will: a) generate the updated SOW; b) add a DocuSign route for your procurement team; c) schedule a 15‑minute call with Camila (on onboarding cadence) and Sergio (on capacity planning).

Attachments: 2026-10-02_Brightwell_repack_summary.xlsx (updated), Brightwell_MAAP_pricing_v2.pdf

Rafael
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara@brightwell.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal discussion — term packaging options

Hi Sara — looping in a quick ops note from the onboarding side.

- Capacity planning: Sergio and I recommend an initial buffer pool equal to 25% of your expected month‑10 token volume to cover warm‑up and unexpected spikes during the staged uptier transitions. That buffer can be consumed before billing triggers the next tier.
- Technical checkpoints: we propose runbooks at month 3 and month 9 to validate latency/KSIs and to adjust batching/quantization suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
- Procurement checklist: Rafael — when you send the SOW please include a short appendix with the billing schedule and the contact list for invoice distribution (AP email + billing contact).

Happy to join the procurement call if you want live support.

Cheers,
Camila
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Brightwell Procurement <procurement@brightwell.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal discussion — term packaging options

Rafael / Camila — procurement has reviewed the updated worksheet and the annual invoice option looks acceptable despite the small processing premium. Legal confirmed the 90‑day opt‑out window. Please proceed with: (1) updated SOW with annual invoicing terms, (2) DocuSign route to procurement@brightwell.com and sara@brightwell.com, and (3) a kickoff call next Tuesday 10/13 at 10am PT to walk the ops checklist.
